description: Resilience layer, DocuSign auth+API client, and normalization. Depends on FEAT-001 (config, security). Implements the retry/rate-limit engine, DocuSign JWT auth client, all four DocuSign API methods (envelopes/recipients/documents/templates), normalization structs with struct tags, and all associated unit tests using mock HTTP servers.
steps: 1. Create internal/resilience/retry.go: RetryConfig struct (MaxAttempts int, BaseDelayMs int, MaxDelayMs int). DoWithRetry(ctx context.Context, cfg RetryConfig, fn func(ctx context.Context) (*http.Response, error)) (*http.Response, error). Retries on: net.Error (timeout/temporary), http 500/502/503/504. Does NOT retry on 400/401/403/404/409. Exponential backoff with full jitter: delay = random(0, min(MaxDelayMs, BaseDelayMs * 2^attempt)). Respects ctx.Done() between attempts. Never retries more than MaxAttempts times total.

2. Create internal/resilience/rate_limiter.go: DoWithRateLimit(ctx context.Context, retryCfg RetryConfig, maxWaitSecs int, fallbackDelaySecs int, fn func(ctx context.Context) (*http.Response, error)) (*http.Response, error). Wraps DoWithRetry. On HTTP 429: parse Retry-After header (integer seconds or HTTP-date format RFC1123); sleep that duration (max maxWaitSecs); retry the call — 429 does NOT consume an attempt from retryCfg.MaxAttempts. If Retry-After absent, sleep fallbackDelaySecs.

3. Create internal/resilience/retry_test.go: mock httptest.Server returning 503 twice then 200 — verifies 2 retries occurred and final result is 200. Mock returning 401 — verifies no retry. Mock with ctx cancelled — verifies context error returned promptly.

4. Create internal/resilience/rate_limiter_test.go: mock returning 429 with Retry-After: 1 header then 200 — verifies 429 did not count as retry attempt and final result is 200. Mock returning 429 without header — verifies fallback delay used. Mock returning 429 repeatedly beyond maxWaitSecs — verifies eventual failure.

5. Create internal/docusign/auth.go: JWTAuthClient struct (integrationKey, userID, privateKeyPEM []byte, authServer, accountID, baseURI string, mu sync.Mutex, cachedToken string, tokenExpiry time.Time). NewJWTAuthClient(cfg *config.Config) (*JWTAuthClient, error) — reads PEM file from cfg.DocuSignPrivateKeyPath. GetAccessToken(ctx) (string, error) — if cached token expires in >5 min, return it; else call fetchToken. fetchToken: build JWT Claims (iss=integrationKey, sub=userID, aud=authServer_hostname_only, iat=now, exp=now+3600, scope='signature impersonation'), sign with RS256 using golang-jwt/jwt/v5, POST to https://{authServer}/oauth/token with form body grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion={jwt}. Parse response for access_token and expires_in. If accountID/baseURI not pre-configured, call resolveAccountInfo. resolveAccountInfo: GET https://{authServer}/oauth/userinfo with Bearer token, find matching account by accountID or use first account, set baseURI from account.base_uri. NEVER log the token, privateKeyPEM, or assertion. ValidateCredentials(ctx) error — calls GetAccessToken then resolveAccountInfo, returns nil on success.

6. Create internal/docusign/client.go: DSClient struct (auth *JWTAuthClient, httpClient *http.Client, resilienceCfg resilience.Config, maxDocuSignRequests int, semaphore chan struct{}). NewDSClient(auth *JWTAuthClient, cfg *config.Config) *DSClient. doRequest(ctx, method, url string, out interface{}) error — acquires semaphore, calls auth.GetAccessToken, sets Authorization header, calls resilience.DoWithRateLimit, reads body with io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 10MB), json.Unmarshal into out, releases semaphore. handleHTTPError(resp) error — reads body and returns descriptive error for 4xx/5xx.

7. Create internal/docusign/envelopes.go: EnvelopeListResponse struct (Envelopes []RawEnvelope, ResultSetSize int, TotalSetSize int, EndPosition int, NextUri string). RawEnvelope struct with all fields used by normalization (EnvelopeId, Status, Subject, SenderName, SenderEmail, CreatedDateTime, LastModifiedDateTime, SentDateTime, CompletedDateTime, ExpiresAfter, DeclinedDateTime, VoidedDateTime, VoidedReason, EmailSubject, InitialSentDateTime). ListEnvelopes(ctx context.Context, accountID, fromDate, toDate string, startPos, count int) (*EnvelopeListResponse, error) — builds URL with query params, calls doRequest.

8. Create internal/docusign/recipients.go: RecipientsResponse struct (Signers []RawRecipient, CarbonCopies []RawRecipient, CertifiedDeliveries []RawRecipient, Editors []RawRecipient, Witnesses []RawRecipient). RawRecipient struct (RecipientId, Name, Email, Status, RoutingOrder, SignedDateTime, DeliveredDateTime, DeclinedDateTime, DeclineReason, Note, RoleName, ClientUserId, CreatedDateTime). GetRecipients(ctx, accountID, envelopeID string) (*RecipientsResponse, error).

9. Create internal/docusign/documents.go: DocumentsResponse struct (EnvelopeDocuments []RawDocument). RawDocument struct (DocumentId, Name, Type, FileExtension, PageCount, Order, Uri). GetDocuments(ctx, accountID, envelopeID string) (*DocumentsResponse, error).

10. Create internal/docusign/templates.go: TemplatesResponse struct (EnvelopeTemplates []RawTemplate, ResultSetSize int, TotalSetSize int, EndPosition int). RawTemplate struct (TemplateId, Name, Description, Shared, PageCount, CreatedDateTime, LastModifiedDateTime, FolderName, FolderId, Status). ListTemplates(ctx, accountID string, startPos, count int) (*TemplatesResponse, error).

11. Create internal/normalization/envelopes.go: NormalizedEnvelope struct with parquet struct tags (`parquet:"envelope_id"` etc.) and json tags. Fields: EnvelopeID, AccountID, OrganizationID, Status, Subject, SenderName, SenderEmail, CreatedAt, LastModifiedAt, SentAt, CompletedAt, ExpiresAt, DeclinedAt, VoidedAt *time.Time, VoidedReason *string, EmailSubject *string, InitialSentAt *time.Time, IsTemplate bool. NormalizeEnvelope(raw docusign.RawEnvelope, accountID, orgID string) NormalizedEnvelope. parseTime helper: parses DocuSign ISO-8601 strings, returns nil *time.Time on empty/invalid.

12. Create internal/normalization/recipients.go: NormalizedRecipient struct with parquet+json tags. Fields: RecipientID, EnvelopeID, AccountID, OrganizationID, RecipientType, Name, Email, Status, RoutingOrder int, SignedAt, DeliveredAt, DeclinedAt *time.Time, DeclineReason, Note, RoleName, ClientUserID *string, CreatedAt *time.Time. NormalizeRecipients(raw docusign.RecipientsResponse, envelopeID, accountID, orgID string) []NormalizedRecipient — flattens all recipient types, setting RecipientType to 'signer'/'carbon_copy'/etc.

13. Create internal/normalization/documents.go: NormalizedDocument struct. Fields: DocumentID, EnvelopeID, AccountID, OrganizationID, Name, DocumentType, FileExtension *string, PageCount *int, Order *int, URI string, CreatedAt *time.Time. NormalizeDocuments(raw docusign.DocumentsResponse, envelopeID, accountID, orgID string) []NormalizedDocument.

14. Create internal/normalization/templates.go: NormalizedTemplate struct. Fields: TemplateID, AccountID, OrganizationID, Name, Description *string, Shared bool, PageCount *int, CreatedAt, LastModifiedAt *time.Time, FolderName, FolderID *string, Status string. NormalizeTemplate(raw docusign.RawTemplate, accountID, orgID string) NormalizedTemplate.

15. Create internal/normalization/envelopes_test.go, recipients_test.go, documents_test.go, templates_test.go: each uses a hardcoded RawXxx struct with realistic DocuSign field values and verifies the Normalize function produces the expected NormalizedXxx output, including correct time parsing and nil handling for missing optional fields.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./internal/resilience/... passes all mock-server retry and rate-limit tests
go test ./internal/normalization/... passes all normalization unit tests
